author: Flick Connection
description:
There’s a streaming service that lets you watch free movies with ZERO ads… and most people have never heard of it.

In this video I’m showing you how to access thousands of free movies online legally, including indie films, cult classics, documentaries, and award winning movies that are surprisingly hard to find on major streaming platforms.

The best part?
There are no commercials, no subscription, and no hidden fees whatsoever!

All you need is a public or University library card.

The streaming service is called Kanopy, and it’s one of the most underrated ways to watch free movies online. Through participating libraries (most libraries participate), you can stream high-quality films completely free including titles that never appear on Netflix, Prime Video, or other major platforms.

If you’re tired of expensive subscriptions and/or endless ads, this is the best free streaming service you’ve never heard of.

In this video I’ll show you:

• how Kanopy works
• how to sign up with you
title: Your Taxes Pay for This Streaming Service (Use It)
